name: War Quarter
summary: In the War Quarter, Lordaeron's Forsaken hone weapons and shadow magic for their fledgling kingdom. Training halls, weapon masters, and heavy industry fill the Undercity's northwest.

sections.title: The Forsaken Garrison
sections.body: Rank-and-file guards and elite champions drill beneath the War Quarter's gloomy stone arches. There, ruthless iron warfare meets the chilling rites of shadow. The Altar of Darkness stands at its heart.

sections.title: Forge and Steel
sections.body: Warrior and priest guilds make the War Quarter the heart of Undercity's wartime production. Blacksmiths and smelters ring the stone with their labor as weapon masters prepare blades and armor. Iron forged deep underground arms the forces defending Lordaeron's ruins from the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the War Quarter?
faq.answer: The War Quarter is the Undercity's military headquarters. Its training grounds serve warriors and priests, while blacksmithing and mining centers keep the Forsaken army armed and armored.

faq.q: Why are priests located in the War Quarter?
aliases: why are priests in war quarter
faq.answer: Forsaken priests largely practice the discipline of the Shadow, wielding it beside warriors rather than tending pastoral sanctuaries. Their place near the martial forces and the Altar of Darkness binds faith closely to the Forsaken's defense.

faq.q: What is the Altar of Darkness?
faq.answer: The Altar of Darkness is a focal point of dark spiritual power in the War Quarter. It is tied to the Forsaken's dark rites and training, and anchors the shadow magic their priests and champions wield.

faq.q: Where is the War Quarter located in the Undercity?
faq.answer: The War Quarter occupies the northwest of the Undercity's circular layout, northwest of the central Trade Quarter. It lies between the Magic Quarter to the east and the Apothecarium to the south.

angles.text: As a warrior, the War Quarter is your primary haven in the Undercity. Weapon masters, advanced combat instructors, and heavy armories prepare you for Lordaeron's brutal frontline battles.
As a blacksmith, you find training masters and high-heat anvils in the War Quarter. It is the central hub for smiths forging munitions and plate for the Forsaken war effort.
